decision.title: Phase 7 plan: one packet per deferred feature, optional features for size (packet )
decision.summary: Phase 7 is planned as one packet per deferred feature, from optional features and the size budget through streaming, Update, HTML5, Full Text and UCA to a review, each reusing existing mechanisms with its own gate.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . Plans Phase 7 () in docs/tasks/phase-7.md, as planned Phase 5.

item.p: Packets (numbers in wave order; "a, b" are packet groups):
7.2: optional features and the size budget;
7.3: xsl:evaluate;
7.4: XSLT backwards-compatible behaviour and XPath 1.0 compatibility mode;
7.5: disable-output-escaping;
7.6a, b: streaming (streamability analysis, then streamed evaluation);
7.7a, b, c: the Update Facility;
7.8: EXPath Binary;
7.9: EXPath File;
7.10a, b: HTML5;
7.11: fn:transform;
7.12a, b, c: Full Text;
7.13: XML 1.1 input;
7.14a, b: DTD processing;
7.15a, b: UCA;
7.16: timezone database;
7.17: calendars and languages;
7.18: Invisible XML;
7.19: review.
7.3, 7.5, 7.13 and 7.14 are proposed for the owner (below). The order weighs the cases unlocked, user demand and risk:
7.4 comes early because every version="1.0" stylesheet now raises XTDE0160 when evaluated;
Full Text is late because it is the riskiest;
UCA, timezones, languages and iXML come last: they are few cases and much data.
Counts (not run at 3b0812a; first unmet dependency where the dashboard has it, else from the catalogs):
XT40: streaming 2,932, backwards compatibility 124, xsl:evaluate 83, dtd 78, XML 1.1 65, disable-output-escaping 32, numbering languages 14;
XQ40: HTML 1,401, Update 825, Full Text 685, Binary 673, XML 1.1 313, File 271, fn:transform 133, UCA 49 (+13), infoset-dtd 32, languages 24, Olson 8, iXML 10, XPath 1.0 mode 5;
xmlconf: 275 XML 1.1 cases and 265 with external entities.
About 4,400 of XQ40's 5,505 not-run cases and 3,330 of XT40's 4,659. staticTyping, the xsl-stylesheet PI, HTML4 output, XInclude and remote_http stay unplanned (listed in the plan).
Mechanisms, no parallel machinery:
xsl:evaluate and fn:transform compile at run time and run a unit evaluation (, ); fn:transform is supplied by the XSLT layer, as fn:load-xquery-module is supplied by XQuery.
HTML5, iXML, XML 1.1 and DTD entities send tree builder events; HTML tree construction works on a working node table first, because the adoption agency moves built nodes.
DTD validation is schema validation against components built from the DTD.
Updates are applied by rebuilding trees through the tree builder, so tree.h stays frozen (node identity across an update is not observable within a snapshot).
Streaming is first a static streamability pass with unstreamed evaluation, which yields every result and static error; then a receiving task () fed by the parser. The feature is claimed only then.
Full Text selections compile into a match program as regexes do (); Full Text goes in the XQuery grammar only.
The XPath 1.0 mode is a static-context flag that the lowering reads.
disable-output-escaping uses the JAXP processing-instruction pair, because text nodes cannot carry a mark.

Header changes (additive, each with its record): processor.h (optional features, a file-system interface, resource kinds for Full Text, entities and optionally collation and timezone data), xpath.h (the 1.0 compatibility flag), xquery.h (updating queries), xml.h (DTD options). No substrate header changes.

Gates (proposed): each feature has its own gate in its packet, from 75 % (Full Text, languages) to 95 % (Binary, HTML5, the xmlconf cases). The Phase 7 gate is every accepted feature's gate, the earlier gates still held with no passed count dropped, no error outcome, the owner's size budgets, and fuzz targets for every new parser.
PLAN.md: the Phase 7 row names the optional features and the four proposed additions.
